h1.title: Bumpy · Liked You · H1 Proof of real
h1.heading: H1 · Proof of real
h1.lead: Every blurred card shows the country, the reaction type, Verified and Active today (only when true). The paywall opens with the real counts.
h1.panel_html:
Hypothesis

If we show on every blurred card the sender’s country, the reaction type (Like / Hello) and “Active today” only when it is true, and open the paywall with real counts,

then the share of Liked You openers who tap a card or “See who liked you” will increase, and so will Gold purchases per opener, with no rise in fake-profile reports,

because today a like can’t be checked before paying (“I think they are bots to make me pay”), users ask for the country, and partial information makes people more curious than none.

Primary metric: share of openers who tap a card or the CTA (baseline 3.1%). Guardrails: fake-profile reports, revenue per opener.

screens.title: H1-01 · Push
screens.note: Push says what and where. Reaction type + country + verified, never a name or photo, so it is safe with hidden previews. Tap → Liked You.

screens.title: H1-02 · Liked You · 3 reactions
screens.note: Blurred, but checkable. Each card shows country, Like / Hello, Verified and Active today (only when true); the header shows the real counts. Card → reveal sheet · Verified / Active → trust sheet · CTA → paywall.

screens.title: H1-03 · Why you can trust this Like
screens.note: Answer “are they bots?” in place. Where each signal comes from, plus two promises: no fake Likes, only the country before a reveal. Got it / scrim → Liked You.

screens.title: H1-04 · Reveal sheet
screens.note: Same signals at the decision point. The ad reveal is unchanged in H1 (it is tested in H2). Watch ad → ad · See who liked you → paywall · X → Liked You.

screens.title: H1-05 · Rewarded ad
screens.note: Rewarded ad, as today. Kept as in the current app to isolate H1. After 3 s → the current profile screen.

screens.title: H1-06 · Get Gold · real counts
screens.note: The paywall sells what the user has seen. Same counts as the cards; blurred avatars are the real likers. Monthly pre-selected, price on the button, Restore / Terms / Privacy visible. Continue → App Store · X → Liked You.

screens.title: H1-07 · App Store purchase
screens.note: System purchase sheet with plan, price and renewal terms. Tap the sheet to confirm · Cancel → paywall.

screens.title: H1-08 · Liked You · after Gold
screens.note: After Gold: back to the same list. Everyone is revealed, the card the user came for is highlighted. Tap Ayesha → profile.
